firstPlayerRule: Determine the first player or team by chance, or use the order set by the club or tournament organizers. In doubles, the starting team chooses which partner takes the first shot.
clarifications: Turns proceed clockwise. In singles, players alternate who starts each round. In doubles, the obligation to start moves one player clockwise for each subsequent round.
